popcorn.lore.rare: Hides one unpopped kernel in every handful, waiting for the softest tooth.

taco.lore.rare: Shatters into so many pieces at the first bite that the plate ends up with more taco than the mouth.

x_apple_pie.lore.epic: Was left to cool on a windowsill, and three neighbours and a fox turned up to admire it.

x_gyro.lore.rare: Gets wrapped so tightly that the last bite squirts sauce right up its eater's sleeve.

x_pizza_slice_box.lore.legendary: Fed a whole party from one box, and somehow there was still a slice left for the pizza delivery rider.

x_quesadilla_plate.lore.uncommon: Lets one wedge slide off the plate every time it is carried to the table.
x_quesadilla_plate.lore.rare: Hides a pocket of molten cheese in its middle wedge, so whoever gets it gasps.
x_quesadilla_plate.lore.epic: Was cut into so many wedges at a party that it looked like a giant golden clock.

x_shawarma.lore.rare: Turns on its spit so hypnotically that the whole queue forgets what it was going to order.

x_crepe.lore.common: Gets rolled round lemon and sugar and is gone in about three bites.
x_crepe.lore.legendary: Was spread so wide on a market stall that it covered the whole griddle and was cut into twenty slices.

x_tamale.lore.rare: Keeps its filling so hot inside the husk that it is still steaming an hour after it is served.

x_cinnamon_roll.lore.rare: Makes anyone who unrolls it eat the middle last, saving the gooiest swirl for the end.

x_cream_puff.lore.rare: Hides so much cream inside that one bite fills a whole mouth and a moustache.

x_custard.lore.rare: Turns any plain pudding into a favourite the moment it is poured over the top.

x_danish.lore.rare: Makes a whole meeting go quiet when its box is opened, while everyone eyes the cherry one.

x_samosa.lore.uncommon: Leaves a trail of crispy pastry crumbs from the plate to the sofa.

x_sausage_roll.lore.rare: Disappears from any party plate so fast that the host never gets to eat one.

x_spring_roll.lore.rare: Gets dunked in sweet chilli sauce so deep that the sauce pot needs refilling after every roll.

x_tart.lore.uncommon: Rolls its top grape off the side whenever the plate is tilted.
